title: The Message Left Unsent

voiceProfile.tense: Present tense adult reflection (2024), past tense memories (2015–2021)
voiceProfile.register: Intimate, restrained, lyrical, free of melodrama or self-pity

characters.name: Nikhil Verma
characters.description: Brand strategist in Delhi. Thoughtful, guarded, prone to over-analyzing moments long after they have passed.
characters.internalConflict: Has spent nine years nurturing a phantom conversation in his drafts folder as a surrogate for real closure.

characters.name: Ananya Sen
characters.description: Environmental economist now living in Montreal. Practical, courageous, direct.
characters.significance: The woman he loved but lacked the courage to ask to stay.

motifs: The drafts folder count (1 draft, 428 words, modified 34 times)
